C0352.title: Jiangsu Yancheng Police Dismantle Credential Stuffing Account Theft Ring
C0352.summary: In April 2021, police in Yancheng, Jiangsu Province uncovered a criminal group using credential stuffing techniques. The group aggregated leaked username-password pairs from the internet, built a database, and launched mass login attempts against a major e-commerce platform, reaching up to one million abnormal logins per day.
